details: graphcore-js is a renamed copy of the graphlib graph library published by the npm account monawillis412 (author "Mona Willis"), which JFrog links to the GRAPHCORE-JS GitHub organization. It belongs to a Graphalgo-linked campaign of look-alike npm libraries whose hidden loaders decrypt a second stage fetched from Ethereum and Base Sepolia smart contracts and use Slack and Telegram for command and control. JFrog Security Research and SafeDep both list graphcore-js versions 2.3.2, 2.3.4, 2.4.1 and 2.4.2 among the campaign's malicious packages (first seen 2026-03-17). The account published 17 versions between 2026-02-27 and 2026-03-09; npm has removed all but 2.4.4. This report lists the four versions both sources name.
